title.zh: 修订第731号法（拨款100万美元购买菲律宾群岛辅币所需银、铜及其他金属或合金），规定拨款还可用于购买铸币所需金属、制作必要模具及其他铸币费用、将铸成硬币从美国造币厂运往菲律宾群岛的运输和保险费用，以及使硬币投入流通的其他费用。

title.vi: Luật sửa Đạo luật số 731 về cấp 1 triệu đô la Mỹ mua bạc, đồng và kim loại hoặc hợp kim khác để đúc tiền lẻ tại Philippines, cho phép dùng khoản tiền này mua kim loại đúc tiền, chế tạo khuôn cần thiết, thanh toán chi phí đúc, vận chuyển và bảo hiểm tiền xu từ xưởng đúc tiền Hoa Kỳ đến Philippines, cùng các chi phí đưa tiền vào lưu thông.
title.th: กฎหมายแก้ไขกฎหมายหมายเลข 731 ซึ่งจัดสรรเงิน 1 ล้านดอลลาร์สหรัฐเพื่อซื้อเงิน ทองแดง และโลหะหรือโลหะผสมอื่นสำหรับผลิตเหรียญย่อยในฟิลิปปินส์ โดยอนุญาตให้ใช้เงินดังกล่าวซื้อโลหะ ทำแม่พิมพ์ที่จำเป็น จ่ายค่าใช้จ่ายในการผลิตเหรียญ ค่าขนส่งและประกันภัยเหรียญจากโรงกษาปณ์สหรัฐฯ ไปยังฟิลิปปินส์ และค่าใช้จ่ายอื่นในการนำเหรียญออกใช้
title.id: Undang-undang yang mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor 731 tentang alokasi 1 juta dolar AS untuk membeli perak, tembaga, dan logam atau paduan lain bagi pencetakan uang pecahan Filipina, dengan mengizinkan dana dipakai untuk membeli logam, membuat cetakan, biaya pencetakan, pengangkutan dan asuransi koin dari percetakan uang AS ke Filipina, serta biaya lain untuk mengedarkannya.
title.ms: Akta meminda Akta No. 731 yang memperuntukkan AS$1 juta bagi pembelian perak, tembaga dan logam atau aloi lain untuk menempa syiling kecil Filipina, dengan membenarkan dana digunakan bagi membeli logam, membuat acuan, kos penempaan, pengangkutan dan insurans syiling dari kilang wang AS ke Filipina, serta perbelanjaan lain untuk mengedarkannya.

text.en:
Section one of Act Numbered Seven hundred and thirty-one, entitled "An Act appropriating one
million dollars, in money of the United States, for the purchase of silver, copper, and other metals or allows
needed in the coinage of subsidiary coins for use in the Philippine Islands," is hereby amended by providing
that the money appropriated may be expended not only for the purchase of bullion needed in the coinage but
also for the making of necessary dies and other expenses of coinage, for the cost of transporting coins, when
coined, from the mints of the United States to the Philippine Islands, including the necessary insurance, and
for all other expenses of putting such coins into circulation.

All moneys heretofore disbursed by the Disbursing Agent of the Philippine Government in
Washington, for the purposes mentioned in the preceding section, are hereby ratified and confirmed.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, May 27, 1903.
